reply.answer_text: I can help with this, but I need to verify the customer's identity first. Once verified, we can update the address on the system — it's usually done same day. We'll send confirmation letters to both the old and new addresses. However, I'm not able to handle this directly as a front-office assistant — you'll need to pass this to the back office with the new address, and they will update it.
